properties.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 1 at 11:04PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm...
Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 20-60 nm...

* At 1104 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm,
capable of producing winds to around 30 knots. This strong
thunderstorm was located over Grant-Valkaria, or over Malabar,
moving northwest at 25 knots. Other gusty showers and embedded
storms will lift north from Indian River county, and extending well
offshore.

Locations impacted include...
Floridana Beach, Melbourne Shores, Sebastian Inlet, Grant-Valkaria,
Barefoot Bay, Micco, Roseland, North Beach, Melbourne Beach,
Malabar, Indialantic, Orchid, Sebastian, Wabasso, Indian Harbour
Beach and Palm Bay.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, lightning strikes, and heavy downpours. Boaters should seek
safe harbor immediately until this storm passes.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 1 at 10:02PM CST by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
At 1002 PM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 7
miles northeast of Texline, or 31 miles southwest of Boise City,
moving northeast at 50 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Texline and Felt.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

NWSheadline: A STRONG THUNDERSTORM WILL IMPACT SOUTHWESTERN CIMARRON AND NORTHWESTERN DALLAM COUNTIES UNTIL 1030 PM CST

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 1 at 9:01PM MST until November 2 at 8:00AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM MST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Verde River between Bartlett Lake and the
Salt River is occurring. Recreation on or near the Verde River will
be unsafe.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 856 PM MST, a USGS gauge on the Verde River below Bartlett Dam
measured a stage above 24 ft and a flow around 29,000 cfs.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Rio Verde and Fort McDowell.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 AM MST MONDAY
